resultat: Forrest Griffin bat Stephan Bonnar par décision unanime après 3 rounds.
resultat_en: Forrest Griffin defeats Stephan Bonnar by unanimous decision after 3 rounds.
contexte: Finale de la première saison de The Ultimate Fighter, première diffusion en direct de l'UFC hors pay-per-view. Griffin gagne aux points ; Bonnar et lui reçoivent tous deux un contrat.
contexte_en: The final of the first season of The Ultimate Fighter, the UFC's first live broadcast outside pay-per-view. Griffin won on points; he and Bonnar were both given contracts.
